title: search.query
description: Run a search from a server-side caller. The payload is the same parameter set GET /search/api/v1/query accepts (type, q, lang, category, f.<slug>, r.<slug>, lat/lon/radius_km or bbox, sort, facets, limit, anchor, direction) and the answer is the same envelope: {items, facets, facet_meta, next_anchor, prev_anchor, has_next, has_prev, count, exact_total, degraded, backend, sort, took_ms}. Every item carries `promoted` (DSA Art. 26) under every sort, including when it is false.

type.description: Registered doc_type; one type per query (no federated search in v1).

q.description: Free text; dictionary-normalized, morphology is the engine's.

lang.description: Language code selecting the FTS config and dictionary.

anchor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous answer.

bbox.description: minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon; minLon > maxLon crosses the antimeridian.
